exact_bridge.statement: H/Z(H) is explicitly conjugate on its normal F2^4 module to the even-parastrophe subgroup of the Klein V4 Latin-square autoparatopy group.

negative_result: The two order-576 groups H and AutPar(V4) are not isomorphic: their centers, derived subgroup orders and element-order spectra differ.
boundary: The equality 576=576 is not used as evidence by itself. The theorem is the explicit order-288 affine quotient identification; no physical meaning is assigned to the central involution.
